name: Carlos
site: lufthansa-group-business-services.com · Business services for aviation, Germany
headline: Turn Lufthansa’s usage data into services that stay.
saw: Your homepage presents seven service areas, from Procurement Services to Health Management, to every business visitor in the same way, whether they come for payroll, fuel purchasing or occupational safety.

Once a client team is using these services, which modules they open, how often they order and where they stop is your strongest signal for the next service and the next drop-off. It sits in analytics today, not in the message they receive.
Cross-sell, upsell and retention campaigns are built by hand, per segment, per quarter. The client team about to drop a service next week gets the same offer as everyone else, or none at all.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per customer, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Stop the drop-off before it happens
cases.text: Per customer churn signals from usage, order frequency and support contacts across your service areas. The right offer, channel and moment, picked for each client team and tested continuously.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Offer the next service when it fits
cases.text: Next best service per customer, triggered by what they already order and which modules they never open. No more blanket emails to teams that already use the service.
cases.kpi_label: category subscriptions at an OTT client

cases.head: Keep every service in use, every week
cases.text: Personal reminders and module suggestions per customer, orchestrated across the channels they already use, so every client team sees a reason to return to the services each week.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
